main_text.p: re aliena, quæ calumnia non tantum solide refutatur, verumetiam multæ quæstiones Catechefeos paucis & rotundis verbis declaratæ confirmantur, vt de nomine Christianorum, de condemnatione filij Dei sub Pontio Pilato, de ascensione & sessione ad dextram potentiæ Dei, de Sacramentis, de pœnitentia, de iureiurando, de oratione, & de aliis, quæ in libro cui titulus est grünbt licher bericht/ & in defensione Catechismi verbose explicantur. Responsio ad interrogationes quasdam de cœna, nec non quæstiones interrogationibus illis oppositæ eò spectant vt demonstretur vociferationis πε-ρὶ τῦ ῥήτῦ vanitas, impedimenta simplicioribus obijciens, quo minus verum sensum assequi possint. Atque hunc laborem optimo consilio susceptum Lector Christianus in bonam partem accipiet sibiq; commendatum habebit.

page.notes: Greek phrase "περὶ τοῦ ῥήτοῦ" is printed with a faint and partly smudged accent; transcribed as best read. The black-letter words are German in the original. The page carries a fragment of show-through from the reverse, not transcribed. A stray mark appears near the top left, not a note.
